paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua bar Abba, in Ulla’s name: Shabbat 126a and Moed Katan 5b. ‘Rav Giddel said: Rav said’: Menachot 30a, several laws. Bava Batra 15a. In Zevachim 32b: Rav Yehoshua raised an objection to Ulla, and so forth; he replied, ‘Your own argument answers you’—perhaps this was Rabbi Yehoshua bar Abba. Perhaps Rabbi Yitzchak bar Abba was his brother.
